samples.gold:
CREATE TABLE users (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  username TEXT,
  password TEXT,
  activation_key TEXT,
  reset_key TEXT,
  email TEXT,
  activated INTEGER,
  created TEXT,
  updated TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE systems (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT,
  description TEXT,
  repository TEXT,
  created TEXT,
  updated TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE roles (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT,
  created TEXT,
  updated TEXT,
  system_id INTEGER,
  FOREIGN KEY (system_id) REFERENCES systems(id)
);

CREATE TABLE permissions (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT,
  created TEXT,
  updated TEXT,
  role_id INTEGER,
  FOREIGN KEY (role_id) REFERENCES roles(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (role_id) REFERENCES roles(id)
);

CREATE TABLE systems_users (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  system_id INTEGER,
  user_id INTEGER,
  created TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (system_id) REFERENCES systems(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
);

CREATE TABLE systems_users_permissions (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  system_id INTEGER,
  user_id INTEGER,
  permission_id INTEGER,
  created TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY (system_id) REFERENCES systems(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (permission_id) REFERENCES permissions(id)
);
